New plan: 

In my previous attempt, I correctly identified the order of operations (PEMDAS) and applied it to the given Boolean expression. However, I failed to recognize that the expression "not not not not not not not True" can be simplified using the double negation law, which states that "not not P" is equivalent to "P". 

Next time, I will apply this law to simplify the expression before evaluating it. I will rewrite the expression as "not True" and then apply the NOT operator. This will give me the correct result without having to apply the NOT operator multiple times.
